question: Given exhaustive Gate0 failure (0/2 SPAs pass title>=2/H>0.2/leakage<40%/NL>=50 after 20 cross-site +61 web-dynamics experiments) and Bayesian Dirichlet-Multinomial K=12 N=1999 as first estimator to pass C1+C3 on synthetic SPA but absolute BF -10 to -15 nats favoring memory on real TodoMVC, does an orthogonal falsifiable program — timescale separation (autocorrelation decay/lag structure) and barrier/committor quantitation (>=10 revisits to same URL,DOM with divergent futures) on existing TodoMVC/BrowserGym WebShop trajectories using trajectory-grouped permutation and B-DOM-SIMILARITY nulls — reveal beyond-memory predictive structure without requiring new Gate0 SPAs?
hypothesis: On existing TodoMVC SPA trajectories (5 variants: react, vue, angular, svelte, vanillajs from EXP-PHYSICS-35209110569 raw_* TopUp + any BrowserGym WebShop/WebArena trajectories found at research/intel/ or BrowserGym cache) that satisfy relaxed substrate sufficiency (NL>=50 non-leakage transitions, strata>=5, leakage_validOnly<60%, dom_bytes>=500 on >=80% transitions) without requiring Gate0 title>=2/H>0.2, beyond-memory dynamics will manifest orthogonally to pooled density divergence as either (H_T) timescale separation: state autocorrelation ACF(k)=P(S_{t+k}=s|S_t=s) averaged over s decays with two timescales (slow tau_slow > 3*tau_fast) such that lag-3 residual delta_ACF = ACF_obs(3)-mean(ACF_perm_Markov(3)) >=0.10 with trajectory-grouped permutation p<0.005 and Bayesian Dirichlet-Multinomial BF_10 = P(data|order3 Markov with history)/P(data|order1 Markov) >10 (nats >2.3) after fitting on train grouped by trajectory_id, OR (H_B) barrier/committor: among states x=(URL_before_normalized, DOM_before_hash R1 or R2) revisited >=10 times with divergent S_next distributions, committor q(x)=P(hit absorbing set B before A | start x) estimated from divergent futures has variance Var(q)>0.10 with grouped permutation p<0.05 and bimodality Hartigans dip p<0.05, exceeding B-DOM-SIMILARITY and B-MARKOV baselines. Mechanism: TodoMVC hash-SPAs and WebShop personalization/cart/auth regimes create metastable basins (e.g., filter states all/active/completed or cart vs browsing) and dynamical barriers separating basins that are invisible to history-conditioned CMI factorization at K=3 but detectable via dwell-time spectra and committor variance. Correlated synthetic metastable controls must show tau_slow/tau_fast>3 and delta_ACF>0.15 BF>30 and barrier variance>0.15; independent-noise/i.i.d. synthetic must show delta_ACF~0 and variance~0 within null.
falsifier: FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING if on ALL qualifying substrate datasets (Q TodoMVC variants + WebShop if available) that satisfy relaxed sufficiency, for BOTH primary representations R1 visible_text_hash and R2 a11y_tree_hash, BOTH orthogonal prongs fail: (F_T) delta_ACF(3) <0.05 OR grouped p>=0.005 OR BF_10 <=1 (BF nats <=0) favoring order-1 Markov, AND (F_B) either branched_revisit_count <10 (insufficient revisits to test barrier, infeasible but recorded as F_B) OR Var(q) <=0.05 OR grouped p>=0.05 OR dip p>=0.05. This falsifies timescale separation and barrier/committor beyond-memory dynamics via R1/R2 hash representations on TodoMVC/WebShop substrate as defined, bounded to tested state definitions and representations; it does NOT falsify factorization with richer visual/computed-style DOM or production SPAs with correlated latent regimes not captured by these hash SPAs. MEASUREMENT_INVALID if relaxed sufficiency fails on all datasets (0 qualify: NL<50 or strata<5 or dom_bytes insufficient), OR positive controls fail (metastable delta_ACF<0.10 or BF<=10 or barrier variance<0.10 on synthetic), OR null controls degenerate (null_std==0 for ACF makes p undefined or null_q variance std==0 due to singleton revisits), OR preprocessing fit on test, OR site identity leaks, OR resampling unit not trajectory_id. SURVIVES_CURRENT_TEST only if H_T OR H_B meets all thresholds on >=1 qualifying dataset for R1 or R2 with delta_ACF>=0.10 p<0.005 BF>10 (T) or Var(q)>0.10 p<0.05 dip p<0.05 with >=10 revisits (B) and null_std>0.01 and all pipeline gates pass.
baselines: B-MARKOV-ORDER1 (strong Markov order-1): first-order Markov predictor P(S_{t+1}|S_t,A_t) trained on train grouped by trajectory_id; primary null for timescale; ACF under this model decays as lambda_2^k where lambda_2 is second eigenvalue of transition matrix; tests whether slow tail exceeds Markov exponential.

B-MARKOV-K3 (history Markov K=3): P(S_next|URL_before,H_K=3,A_leakageFree) majority vote, same as prior factorization baseline; used to compute BF_10 comparison (order3 vs order1) and to test whether timescale adds beyond K=3 memory.

B-SHUFFLE-GROUPED (trajectory-grouped permutation timescale null): within-trajectory shuffle of state sequence preserving per-trajectory state frequencies and within-trajectory DOM sequences but destroying temporal order; 1000 perms grouped by trajectory_id seed 42; yields null ACF distribution and null dwell-time; valid null_std>0.01 required.

B-DOM-SIMILARITY (kNN/Jaccard ordinary similarity null, mandatory): TF-IDF cosine k=5 over DOM visible_text (R1) and a11y text (R2) fit on TRAIN only, predicting S_next via nearest neighbor without history conditioning; MUST be executed as frozen; timescale separation must exceed similarity-predicted autocorrelation (similarity ACF computed from similarity-induced transition graph) to claim beyond-memory dynamics, not mere content similarity.

B-RANDOM-DWELL (i.i.d. dwell null): synthetic i.i.d. state sequence with same marginal P(S) but independent draws; expected exponential dwell distribution with mean 1/p_stay and delta_ACF=0; tests estimator bias floor.
B-TRAJECTORY-MEMORY: exact (S_t,A_t)->S_{t+1} memorization from train; reports memorization ratio and ceiling for committor; not asserted equal to B-MARKOV-ORDER1.
B-SITE-LEAKAGE-DIAGNOSTIC: action_with_href vs leakageFree gap for ACF delta; reports leakage inflation; valid inference uses leakageFree only.
positive_control: Two synthetic correlated controls (deterministic seeds PYTHONHASHSEED=0 numpy 42) executed on same pipeline: (1) METASTABLE two-well chain: 6 states partitioned into basins B1={0,1,2} B2={3,4,5}, within-basin p_stay=0.85 within-basin transition 0.10, cross-basin p_cross=0.05, plus regime latent L persisting 15 steps P(flip)=0.07 per step modulating basin preference; generates 2000 transitions over 100 trajectories x20 steps; DOM_before=SHA256(L||basin||step_mod_3) with R1/R2 hash mapping, S=URL_hash(state), H(S_next|S,A) ~0.9 bits, expected delta_ACF(3)=0.18-0.25, tau_slow/tau_fast ~8, BF_10>30, dwell-time heavy tail exponent ~ -1.2. Must achieve delta_ACF>=0.12 p_raw<0.005 BF nats>2.3 Var(q) not required for this control. (2) BARRIER double-well chain: 5 linear states 0-1-2-3-4 with barrier at state 2: p(2->1)=p(2->3)=0.05 barrier 0.90 stay, outer states p_stay 0.30, 1000 transitions; revisits to barrier state (URL,DOM)=(2,hash_2) >=30 with divergent futures (q~0.5 variance 0.20). Must achieve Var(q)>=0.12 with grouped p<0.01 dip p<0.05 and branched_revisit_count>=15. Failure of either positive control on its primary criterion => MEASUREMENT_INVALID pipeline blind. Constructions frozen exactly; any outcome-informed change is EXPLORATORY violation.
null_control: Two nulls must both pass for valid inference where applicable: (1) GROUPED-PERMUTATION ACF null: within-trajectory grouped shuffle of S sequence (1000 perms seed 42 trajectory_id) on EACH qualifying dataset and on i.i.d. synthetic; valid null requires null_std>0.01 and |null_mean|<3*null_std and Bonferroni p>0.10 for null datasets; degenerate null_std==0 due to singleton revisits or constant state => MEASUREMENT_INVALID for that representation, not falsification. (2) Independent-noise / i.i.d. synthetic null: i.i.d. state draws with same marginal P(S) as metastable control (seed 42) but independent per step; must show delta_ACF <=0.03 p>0.10 BF nats <0 (favor order1) and Var(q) <=0.03 p>0.10 on barrier null; degenerate constant DOM case triggers MEASUREMENT_INVALID. Also report Bayesian DM null model Dirichlet alpha=1/K prior concentration check (BF calibration on i.i.d. null must favor order1). Singleton revisit rate>50% makes barrier null degenerate => MEASUREMENT_INVALID.
measurement_validity: Relaxed substrate sufficiency (no Gate0): dataset qualifies iff after leakage-free filtering (action href excluded, normalized URL preserved) NL>=50 non-leakage transitions, strata_count>=5 unique (URL_before,H_K=3,Action) with >=3 per stratum, singleton_SA_rate<70%, leakage_validOnly<60% among href-bearing actions, dom_bytes>=500 and a11y non-empty on >=80% transitions. Title variation and H>0.2 NOT required (TodoMVC title=1 entropy 0 by design). If 0 datasets qualify => MEASUREMENT_INVALID substrate_insufficient, publish gate_table.json, do not test H_T/H_B; handoff documents gap. Max 6 datasets (5 TodoMVC variants + WebShop if found) for cost; if WebShop absent, proceed with TodoMVC only and document. Reuse existing trajectories: TodoMVC raw_* files from research/experiments/EXP-PHYSICS-35209110569 (sha256 verified) and any BrowserGym trajectories at research/intel/manifest.json or /tmp/browsergym_cache; do not self-collect new production sites without re-freeze; synthetic controls are local only.

Gated execution: if relaxed sufficiency fails on all datasets, do not evaluate primary H_T/H_B; record MEASUREMENT_INVALID with unresolved substrate; do not substitute locally-hosted Express synthetics for real trajectories beyond controls.

State S (operational) primary: S_primary = SHA256(normalize(URL_after) || '|' || normalize(title_after)) where normalize(URL)=lowercase, strip query params ?session=/?token=, preserve SPA hash fragment #/, strip trailing slash; normalize(title)=trimmed lowercased truncated 200 chars. Exploratory: S_URLonly, S_URL_DOMhash, S_hashFragmentOnly. For timescale, S_t sequence is ordered by trajectory step; for barrier, x=(URL_before_normalized, DOM_before_hash) where DOM_before_hash is R1 or R2 hash (SHA256 5000-char truncation). S_next distinct timestep from DOM_before (no post-state leak).

Action A_leakageFree (operational): A=(primitive, target_sig) primitive in {click, fill, navigate, select, submit, hover} target_sig=role+name+testId+aria-label (never href/URL/src); link target_href never enters A. Diagnostic A_leaky=A+href computed only for leakage gap. Action distribution per dataset reported; policy regularity separated from environment dynamics; Playwright crawler provenance documented (depth 3-5, 10 steps/trajectory for TodoMVC existing).

DOM_before representations (operational, tested independently not ensembled): R1 visible_text_hash=SHA256(visibleText[0:5000] innerText), R2 a11y_tree_hash=SHA256(serialized AX tree role/name/value up to 5k chars Accessibility.getFullAXTree), R3 title_before exact string (exploratory), R4 combined_hash=SHA256(R1||R2) exploratory. Numeric structural features exploratory only. Raw observables preserved (dom_bytes, a11y_bytes, title string) with documented truncation; hash collision/truncation loss disclosed. Primary claim requires R1 or R2 only.

History H_K=3 (operational) for BF comparison: H_K=(A_{t-2},A_{t-1},A_t, S_{t-2},S_{t-1},S_t) last 3 steps; strata key C=(URL_before_normalized, H_K_actions) where URL_before_normalized is URL_only without title to avoid state leakage into condition. Rare strata <3 excluded from ACF point estimate but counted in validity_notes; strata_count and singleton rate reported. For timescale, K=3 history used only for BF order comparison (order1 vs order3 Markov with Dirichlet prior).

Timescale estimator (operational): ACF(k)= (1/(T-k)) sum_{t} 1_{S_t = S_{t+k}} averaged over datasets pooled within trajectory weighting; also normalized autocorrelation Corr(k)= (E[1_{S_t=s}1_{S_{t+k}=s}] - p_s^2)/(p_s(1-p_s)) averaged over s weighted by p_s. Dwell-time distribution P(dwell=d)=fraction of runs of identical S of length d; heavy-tail exponent fitted via MLE. Delta_ACF(k)=ACF_obs(k)-mean(ACF_perm_grouped(k)) bias-corrected, where perm_grouped is 1000 trajectory-grouped shuffles preserving per-trajectory frequencies. Report at k=1,3,5. Primary is k=3 (beyond K=1 Markov). Also report tau via exponential fit ACF(k)~A exp(-k/tau_fast)+B exp(-k/tau_slow) two-exponential mixture, and integrated tau_int=sum_k ACF(k). Bayesian Dirichlet-Multinomial BF: Dirichlet prior alpha=1/K with K=12 states ( Dirichlet-Multinomial marginal likelihood for order1 vs order3 transition counts, N up to 1999 per spec), compute log BF = log P(data|M3)-log P(data|M1) via closed-form Gamma functions; calibrate on synthetic where BF>10 expected for metastable. Report per dataset.

Barrier/committor estimator (operational): for each state x=(URL,DOM_hash) with >=3 revisits, collect futures F = { S_{t+1}, S_{t+2}, dwell_to_absorbing, hit_B_before_A indicator } where absorbing sets A/B defined as two most frequent terminal states per dataset (e.g., for TodoMVC cart states vs browsing states; for WebShop product vs cart); if no absorbing sets defined, use divergent S_next distribution variance as proxy. Committor q(x)=empirical fraction hitting B before A among revisits to x (requires >=10 revisits for primary). Variance Var(q) across x with >=10 revisits, weighted by revisit count. Bimodality via Hartigans dip test on q distribution (dip statistic, p via bootstrap 500). Report branched_revisit_count = #x with >=10 revisits and at least 2 distinct S_next values, divergent_future_rate = branched/ total_revisit_states, Var(q), dip p, feasible_barrier boolean. Require trajectory-grouped permutation for q variance null (shuffle futures among revisits within same x, 1000 perms grouped).

Split integrity: preprocessing (TF-IDF vocab for B-DOM-SIMILARITY, two-exp fit initial params) fit on TRAIN trajectories only; stratified 70/30 train/test split by trajectory_id (grouped); holdout test used only for Markov accuracy BF and for ACF/dwell unbiased estimation; site identity never feature; site_task leakage check performed. Dirichlet prior alpha fitted on train counts only.

Sampling integrity: policy documented per dataset (existing TodoMVC Playwright crawler, WebShop BrowserGym if available); policy action distribution reported and separated; determinism via PYTHONHASHSEED=0, numpy seed 42, sklearn random_state 42; Python hash() not used as seed; trajectory_id is resampling unit.

Uncertainty integrity: resampling unit = trajectory_id (grouped permutation, not transition); correlated transitions within trajectory not treated as independent; no Gaussian jitter bootstrap; report 95% CI via grouped permutation percentiles (2.5th/97.5th) not Gaussian; Bonferroni over Q_datasets * n_prongs * n_reps (Q up to 6 *2 prongs *2 reps=24, alpha 0.05/24=0.00208 rounded to frozen 0.005 for conservatism per prereg; positive controls use raw p<0.005 single test reachable at N=1000 floor 0.001. Report raw and Bonferroni. BF computed exactly no resampling.

Representation integrity: raw observables preserved or documented truncation; derived hashes document loss (hash collision, 5k truncation); result must survive at least one legitimate representation (R1 or R2) with same substantive direction under nosmooth sensitivity where applicable; timescale ACF also reported on S_URLonly sensitivity.

Strong null centering: null distribution is empirical grouped permutation; null_std must be >0.01 for valid centering; degenerate null (|null_std|==0 due to singleton revisit states or constant S sequence) => MEASUREMENT_INVALID for that stratum/representation; do NOT encode as falsification; audit recomputation with grouped vs item-level must be disclosed.

Auditability: all raw transitions, hashes, strata tables, ACF curves, dwell histograms, permutation distributions, committor tables, code paths committed with sha256 in provenance.json; execution must be re-executable from frozen commit yielding byte-identical raw_results.json aside from elapsed; freeze hashes verified before execution.
decision_rule: Relaxed substrate: if 0 qualifying datasets (NL>=50 strata>=5 singleton<70% dom_bytes>=500 on >=80%) => MEASUREMENT_INVALID substrate_insufficient. Else if positive controls fail (METASTABLE delta_ACF(3)<0.12 OR p_raw>=0.005 OR BF nats<=2.3 OR BARRIER Var(q)<0.12 with revisit>=15 p>=0.01) => MEASUREMENT_INVALID pipeline_blind. Else if null controls degenerate (null_std==0 or |null_mean|>=3*null_std or singleton revisit>50% making q variance undefined) => MEASUREMENT_INVALID for that representation/prong. Else primary: for each qualifying dataset d and each primary rep R in {R1,R2}, compute T_sig(d,R)=1 if delta_ACF_R(3) >=0.10 AND p_bonf<0.005 AND BF_10_R nats>2.3 AND null_std>0.01 AND ACF_obs(3) > B-DOM-SIMILARITY ACF_sim(3) by >=0.05; B_sig(d,R)=1 if branched_revisit_count_R >=10 AND Var(q)_R >0.10 AND p_bonf_q<0.05 AND dip p<0.05 AND null_std_q>0.01. Let Q=#qualifying, S_T=sum_d max_R T_sig, S_B=sum_d max_R B_sig, S= S_T + S_B (count datasets where either prong fires, max 1 per dataset). If Q<=2 and S>=1 => SURVIVES_CURRENT_TEST (timescale or barrier beyond-memory dynamics on this substrate, bounded to tested datasets and R1/R2, orthogonal to pooled TV/KDE/binned PMI). If Q>=3 and S>=2 => SURVIVES_CURRENT_TEST. If S==0 => FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING (no timescale separation beyond Markov and no barrier/committor bimodal variance via R1/R2 on TodoMVC/WebShop substrate as defined; bounded to hash-based state/DOM definitions, does not close production SPAs with correlated latent regimes or richer visual representations). If 0<S<threshold => MIXED/INCONCLUSIVE (partial evidence, report per-dataset table, do not update claim beyond HYPOTHESIS). Exploratory B-DOM-SIMILARITY gap, dwell heavy-tail exponent, tau_slow/tau_fast ratio, and i.i.d. dwell null reported regardless; these do NOT alter primary FALSIFIED verdict but inform director pivot. Sensitivity (nosmooth, S_URLonly) not gating.
product_consequence_positive: SURVIVES validates an orthogonal mechanical prior beyond memory/similarity: timescale separation (slow autocorrelation beyond Markov order1/K3 with BF>10) or barrier/committor bimodality (Var>0.10 with >=10 revisits) on TodoMVC/WebShop via R1/R2 hash DOM. SPIDER should distill dwell-time/timescale detectors as exploration schedulers (allocate more steps to slow basins) and barrier/committor maps as avoidance/bridging priors for parameterized mechanisms (precondition: avoid barrier states or use bridge actions), plus freshness verification sentinels (regime shift when dwell distribution changes). Prioritize BrowserGym/AgentLab collection on title-varying branching shopping/account sites where slow timescales/barriers amplify, and integrate timescale-aware retrieval (recency-weighted by tau) into kernel. Next: quantify transfer across site types, measure cross-site holdout of tau/barrier, and test delta-repair cost when barrier shifts.

Excludes metastable dwell heavy-tail and barrier dynamics on these hash-based DOM/state definitions; pooled TV/KDE/binned PMI already closed, factorization closed, and now timescale/barrier also closed on this substrate. SPIDER should NOT invest in timescale/barrier detectors via hash DOM as mechanical priors; physics lane should pause orthogonal density/dwell/barrier search on this substrate and consider true production SPA correlated latent regime (if Intel manifest ever available) or richer visual/computed-style representations outside hash truncation before further physics spend. Graph/Product continue on trajectory-memory/retrieval without physics prior; product economics must be proven via retrieval/verification/repair amortization alone.
estimated_cost: Low: no LLM calls; reuse existing TodoMVC trajectories (0 collection, analysis only, hash verification) + optional WebShop BrowserGym cached trajectories if found (no new browser launch required; if WebShop missing, proceed with TodoMVC only). Analysis: Python stdlib + numpy/scipy/sklearn (<60 min CPU for 1000 grouped perms x up to 6 datasets x2 reps x2 prongs =24k ACF fits + 1000 committor perms + BF Gamma + TF-IDF fit). Memory <8 GB, no GPU, total <3h wall-clock, deterministic seeds 42. Cold start with 0 qualifying datasets terminates in <10 min as MEASUREMENT_INVALID with gate_table.
expected_information_gain: Very high and tunnel-breaking: first orthogonal test beyond 61 web-dynamics pooled TV/KDE/binned experiments (complementary blind spots kNN fails scaling rho=-0.12 vs KDE fails rotation rho=0.286, 95% pooled attenuation) and beyond 59 synthetic-dominated C-WEB-DYNAMICS factorization experiments (all gated on title>=2/H>0.2 that never materialized 0/5-0/2 manifests, plus independent-noise falsification at 0.004 bits and TodoMVC title degeneracy). Directly tests the director-mandated orthogonal question that avoids Gate0 substrate_unavailable by reusing existing TodoMVC/WebShop trajectories where effect is expressible as dwell spectra/revisit variance without requiring title variation or H>0.2 branching. Uses validated Bayesian Dirichlet-Multinomial K=12 N=1999 null framework (first to pass C1+C3 on synthetic but still absolute BF -10 to -15 nats favoring memory on real TodoMVC, so calibrated), trajectory-grouped permutation (fixes item-level shuffle audit finding), and mandatory B-DOM-SIMILARITY execution. Either SURVIVES (first real-trajectory beyond-memory slow timescale or barrier, product-usable scheduler/guard, expands claim ceiling beyond synthetic 2D) or FALSIFIED (closes orthogonal dwell/barrier path on this substrate, forcing physics to park or await production correlated-regime data) changes C-WEB-DYNAMICS claim and product decision. MEASUREMENT_INVALID (substrate_insufficient if NL<50 or revisits<10) is also informative and refuses false negative. Marginal gain vastly exceeds another synthetic TV/KDE tuning at n=500 or another Gate0 CMI retry that reproducibly yields 0/5.
